name: @siteborne/mcp-server
description: Local stdio shim for the SITEBORNE Utility Network MCP server

scripts.build:
esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/stdio.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ tests/ scripts/ README.md server.json package.json
scripts.pack:verify: pnpm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-packed-install.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run metadata:verify && pnpm run pack:verify
